paragraphs: OSPInsight sells fiber network management software for planning, designing, analyzing, and maintaining fiber networks. That software has been provided to customers for more than 30 years, and OSPInsight has joined IQGeo. Customers can also use Network Manager Telecom, the fiber optic network management software IQGeo offers for telecom and fiber operators. Network Manager Telecom comes in three editions described as meeting the needs of any operator, regardless of size or complexity.

The audience named for Network Manager Telecom is fiber network operators, and the software supports private fiber networks and regional fiber networks for transportation, government, industrial, and corporate networks. IQGeo describes a customer base of fiber, telecom and utility companies worldwide, with over 100,000 active software users.

quote.text: Fiber network management software to help existing OSPInsight customers easily plan, design, analyze, and maintain their networks.
